node.title: Re: keys %{$hash->{$href}} adds $href to the hash if it doesnt exist?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
This is "autovivification" and was just discussed the other day, see the replies in the thread [id://1203377], including the ones deeper down in the thread.

Use [doc://exists] to check if a hash key exists. As described in its documentation, if you have multi-level data structures (hashes of hashes), you need to check every level. Update: [Discipulus] just [id://1203649|updated] to show an example.
